hubs.name: Plaça de l'Ajuntament
hubs.description: The main square. Host to the daily Mascletà and the final Municipal Cremà.

hubs.name: Monteolivete Bridge
hubs.description: Primary location for the Night Fireworks (Castillos) and the grand Nit del Foc.

hubs.name: Plaza de la Virgen
hubs.description: The spiritual heart of the festival. Site of the Flower Offering (L'Ofrena).

hubs.name: Science Museum (Ninot)
hubs.description: Location of the Ninot Exhibition and where the Indultats are proclaimed.

hubs.name: Torres de Serranos
hubs.description: Historic gates where the Crida takes place and major parades pass through.

events.title: Mascletà
events.description: The daily explosion of gunpowder. Today featuring Pirotècnia Aitana with 'La belleza del sonido'.

events.title: Infant Ninot Indultat
events.description: Official proclamation of the one children's figure saved from the flames by popular vote.

events.title: Night Pyro Show
events.description: 'Falles, llum i soroll' by Pirotècnia Tamarit. A combination of light and noise.

events.title: Children's Plantà
events.description: Commissions across the city assemble their children's monuments. The festival officially begins in the streets.

events.title: Mascletà
events.description: By Pirotècnia Valenciana. Expect massive crowds for this Sunday display.

events.title: Ninot Indultat 2026
events.description: The final verdict. One main ninot will be saved from the fire and move to the Fallero Museum.

events.title: L'Alba de les Falles
events.description: A synchronized firework display across all commissions. Today by Pirotècnia Vulcano at the Town Hall.

events.title: The Main Plantà
events.description: The deadline for all major monuments to be fully erected. The city is now an open-air museum.

events.title: Children's Awards
events.description: Ceremony for the best children's monuments in all sections.

events.title: Fireworks Display
events.description: Grand midnight fireworks display lighting up the City of Arts and Sciences.

events.title: Awards Ceremony
events.description: The highly anticipated awards for the main falla monuments and illuminated streets.

events.title: Ofrena de Flors
events.description: Day one of the offering. Thousands of falleros bring carnations to build the Virgin's flower mantle.

events.title: Fireworks Display
events.description: A spectacular night of light and sound.

events.title: Ofrena de Flors
events.description: Conclusion of the offering with the arrival of the Fallera Mayor de Valencia.

events.title: Nit del Foc
events.description: The biggest and most spectacular fireworks display of the year. A must-see.

events.title: Grand Mascletà
events.description: The final explosion of the festival. Today by Pirotècnia Hnos Caballer.

events.title: Cavalcada del Foc
events.description: A parade of fire celebrating the element that will soon consume the monuments.

events.title: Children's Cremà
events.description: The burning of the Municipal children's monument.

events.title: Main Cremà
events.description: The simultaneous burning of all main falla monuments in the city.

events.title: Municipal Cremà
events.description: The final act. The burning of the giant municipal falla marks the end of the festival.
